summary.method: Three alternating fresh Python processes per implementation on the same macOS host; time only load_font_catalog for ten r2 catalogs retained together; process peak RSS sampled before fingerprinting. OS file cache is warm. All dataclass fields, template digests/masks/order, label mappings, lookup values/iteration order, topology and ambiguity counts fingerprinted outside timed region. Not end-to-end PDF timing; timings are machine-specific.

persisted_dxf_regression.method: Fresh recovery on the same persisted DXF inputs with all ten r2 catalogs loaded by the optimized loader. Compare every recognition report field and every entitydb tag (except the validated ezdxf writer timestamp) against rc24 outputs, including original geometry, recovered TEXT, blocks and resources. Catalogs are loaded once and reused; separate full PDF conversions exercise normal uncached loading. Not a rerun of 84 PDFs.

source_pdf_smoke.runtime: source runtime with normal uncached resource loading; all ten catalogs from downloaded r2 bundles

rerun_scope: All ten complete catalogs, 84 persisted font DXFs, eight fresh source PDF conversions. Installed wheel and exact-commit CI are verified separately in release records. The 22 BIM PDFs and 84 matching-face PDFs retain their explicitly versioned rc24 results; the historical 4290-PDF corpus was not rerun.
